title: Semantic Appearance Parameter Transport Foundation
selected_by_owner: 2026-10-04 owner agreed to move from CAS integration design closure into implementation and directed Continue; terminal OARC persistent slot reused for CASI.
objective: Implement the stable CAS-PARAM-1 runtime semantic state and bounded MCCS transport adapters, including detailed head/face parameter transport, without reopening completed MCCS contracts or implementing CAPP rendering, pixel assets, UI, image matching or fashion.

include: runtime CAS-PARAM-1 registry containing the 61 stable parameter IDs/paths, value kinds, groups and bounded scales
CAS-SD1 output-profile identifiers needed by semantic state validation
ordinal5/ordinal7 validation and normalized MCCS numeric transport
body parameter adapter to MCCS-03 morphology/silhouette IDs
bounded head/face parameter transport adjacent to MCCS-05 without modifying canonical anatomy
topology/eligibility/provenance references and explicit unresolved/unsupported state
focused tests proving uniqueness, bounds, determinism, no humanoid fallback and provider-off behavior
exclude: pixel asset generation or PAPT execution
changes to GPR or CWKS branches

dependencies.parallel_lane_rule: GPR PCV-03F and CWKS-05 remain independently in_progress and out of CASI scope.

acceptance: exactly 61 stable core CAS parameters are represented with unique IDs and paths
ordinal5 and ordinal7 values fail closed outside their semantic bounds
same semantic inputs produce deterministic normalized state/checksum regardless of input ordering
body adapter emits stable MCCS-03 morphology/silhouette IDs with bounded numeric transport
head transport carries detailed CAS head/face values with eligibility references and explicit unresolved/unsupported states
no adapter mutates canonical anatomy, mechanics or equipment truth
focused Linux/Windows validation and deterministic comparison are green
next_action: CASI-02 is selected_not_started as the strict successor. It may start only through the CASI lane under OPS3.
